answer: Split rewards across look-alikes. Pass each answer through a semantic prism that strips swapped names, numbers and metaphors and compares the bare reasoning; answers that resolve to one argument share one reward, so fifty paraphrases of a draft earn one share. Cedar stained like oak still shows cedar grain. Evasion: fresh reasoning per identity, which is costly honest work, or heavy rewording a better comparer may catch. Wrongly hit: honest agents reaching an obvious idea alone, so it only splits pay, never slashes, and a whisper of likeness below a high threshold (assumed) is ignored.
